name: development-composition
description: Composition topic plugin — the per-constellation deployment repo type. A composition repo depends on no repository: it pins its members' published container images in a `.claude-workspace.yaml` constellation manifest, declares the environments they are promoted through, and owns promotion. This plugin owns that manifest's `claude-workspace/v1` contract and the validator that enforces it, and the repo-type skeleton bootstrap scaffolds; it does NOT own the member repos' code, contracts or images, which stay with their language plugins. Like development-kubernetes and development-opentofu it can be PRIMARY, because a composition repo has no application language of its own — but not yet: the marker, gather and dispatch land with #1747, so a `primary: composition` declaration today is stale and selects nothing. Shipped: the boundary, the contract and `validate-workspace.zsh` (#1744), and `scaffold-composition.zsh` (#1745) — run by /development:bootstrap on its composition path — which judges the manifest with the validator and then writes it, the promote-to-prod workflow and its `promote.zsh`, the `deploy/` and `e2e/` sockets and `.maintenance.yml`. Still to come: the Renovate image-tag config #1746, the topic marker, gather script and maintenance dispatch #1747, the injection-hardened bump-triage agent #1748 and the how-to #1749. Deployment itself stays out: `deploy_target` accepts only `none` until the compose (#719) and Kubernetes (#720) renderers land, and no run ever reports a deploy that did not happen — a promotion records what it promoted and says nothing was deployed.
